- [EVENT] User asked for guidance on understanding how property taxes are calculated and how to estimate them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained property taxes, including:
  - Purpose of property taxes (funding public services)
  - Components of property tax calculation: assessed value and millage rate
  - Formula for calculating property taxes: Property Tax = (Assessed Value x Millage Rate) / 1,000
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided an example of property tax calculation:
  - Assessed value: $250,000
  - Millage rate: 12.5 mills
  - Property Tax: $3,125 per year
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined steps to estimate property taxes, including researching the millage rate, determining the assessed value, using online calculators, and consulting with a real estate agent.
